findings.title: Source/runtime license-copy drift blocks validation and packaging
findings.release_consequence: Blocks required check and package generation for the current source.
findings.verification_needed: Synchronize intended attribution across owners; rerun required checks and reproducible builds; retain historical receipts.

findings.title: Git omits 23 required evidence logs
findings.release_consequence: Clean GitHub checkout loses promised raw evidence and fails local-reference checks after isolated F-01 correction.
findings.verification_needed: Review and track exact required evidence; check clean Git-tree inventory and local links.

findings.title: Audit and explanation instructions falsely retain an unresolved original-material MIT choice
findings.release_consequence: Can produce contradictory license advice; native reproduction not run.
findings.verification_needed: Update consumers to current outer decision; exercise paired selected/unselected audit and Q&A cases.

findings.title: Failure cleanup deletes an in-place edit to generated output
findings.release_consequence: Bounded preservation-contract defect during later failure and another writer; no general sandbox escape established.
findings.verification_needed: Preserve modified owned bytes and add in-place-edit regression, retaining unchanged/unrelated/replaced cleanup tests and explicit race limits.

findings.title: Release test temporary fixtures encounter macOS symlink ancestors before intended assertions
findings.release_consequence: Default macOS documented test command fails and obscures actual defects; Linux evidence remains scoped.
findings.verification_needed: Canonicalize ordinary fixture roots while retaining deliberate alias tests; rerun default macOS panel after F-01.
